title: [Master]-Applying entries across posting groups (Allow Multiple Posting Groups) posts the G/L entries that move the amount between receivables accounts with ACY = 0
summary: Fixed posting of general ledger entries when applying entries across multiple posting groups, ensuring entries with zero amounts in additional currency are properly handled.
key_points: General ledger entries with ACY=0 are now correctly posted during multiple posting group applications
